dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me about the Melusines?

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Hmm, now that you mention it, I haven't been back to Merusea Village in ages. I wonder how everyone's doing...

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: By the way, that's our hometown! It was where we lived before we came to the Court of Fontaine. Everyone there's really nice. Especially Serene — she's like a big sister to us all!

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: There's Lutine, who makes awesome food, and Topyas and Canotila... Actually, I wonder how they're doing? Guess I should write them a letter, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Aeval
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'm also a bit worried about Mamere... Speaking of which...
